repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: There is no such branch, it is the default branch, the new name is taken, or the gateway refused it.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

sha.description: The commit it points at, in hex, once made.

main.description: Makes the new branch where the old one is, points the open pulls into the old one at the new, then deletes the old, as `knotless branch rename` does; never the default branch. As the account logged in to this appview's web pages: directly for the owner, through the repository's gateway for a collaborator, which refuses anyone else.

description: Renames a branch of a repository.
